site.name: Hummer Mine
overview: Hummer Mine is a documented historic mine in Boulder County's tungsten district. U.S. Geological Survey Professional Paper 245 preserves the Hummer as a named mine and includes a geologic plan of its workings.

timeline.text: The Hummer formed part of the Boulder County tungsten district's network of mine workings.
U.S. Geological Survey Professional Paper 245 documented the Hummer Mine and published a geologic plan of the workings.

moreHistory: Professional Paper 245 places the Hummer Mine at about 8,405 feet elevation and 250 feet north 39 degrees west of the Hoosier shaft.

A USGS-derived mapped mine feature at approximately 39.977487, -105.499442 provides a defensible mine-level identification point. Remnant does not represent that point as a field-surveyed surviving shaft or portal.
